name: Splitter
description: Two-pane split layout with draggable/keyboard-accessible separator; accepts slotted resizable panels.
events: cu-change {position} when dragging finishes or keyboard changes value

accessibility.keyboard: ArrowLeft/Right for left/right, ArrowUp/Down for top/bottom, Home/End extremes, Shift+Arrow 10-point steps
accessibility.pointer: Pointer capture supports mouse, pen and touch, pointercancel restores initial position
accessibility.styling: Focus-visible, semantic colors, high contrast, reduced motion

notes: Use with cu-resizable-panel slot=start and slot=end; author must supply enough host height
